lines.text: Officials hear Jeremiah telling people to surrender to the Chaldeans, and they tell the king he ought to die.
Zedekiah says Jeremiah is in their hands, and they lower him with ropes into a cistern with only sand.
Ebed-melech the Cushite takes thirty men and lowers rags to Jeremiah, and they pull him up with ropes.
Zedekiah meets Jeremiah at the third entrance to the LORD's house and says he fears Pharaoh's soldiers.

wrong_details.true: Jews who have deserted to the Chaldeans

lines.text: Jeremiah tells the officials the king's words, and he remains in the courtyard of the guard until Jerusalem is captured.
